hooks.name: ADR Bilingual Sync
hooks.description: When an ADR under docs/adrs/ is created or modified, detect its language and keep the English/French counterpart in sync by generating or updating the translated copy.

action.prompt:
An ADR file under docs/adrs/ was just created or modified. Keep the bilingual (English/French) pair in sync.

Follow these steps:

1. Identify the saved ADR file and determine its language from the filename convention:
   - A file ending in `.fr.md` is the FRENCH copy.
   - Any other `.md` file (e.g. `0001-title.md`) is the ENGLISH copy.

2. Determine the counterpart path:
   - English `0001-title.md`  <->  French `0001-title.fr.md`
   - The two files share the same numeric prefix and slug; only the `.fr` segment differs.

3. Read the saved file. Then create or update the counterpart so it is a faithful translation:
   - English source -> generate/update the `.fr.md` French copy.
   - French source -> generate/update the base `.md` English copy.

4. Preserve the MADR structure exactly: keep the YAML front matter keys, the section headings, and the Good/Neutral/Bad (Bon/Neutre/Mauvais) bullet conventions. Translate the `status` value too (e.g. accepted <-> accepté, proposed <-> proposé, deprecated <-> déprécié, superseded <-> remplacé).

5. Do NOT translate technical identifiers, code, file names, config keys, or values (e.g. plugin.json, package.json, baseBranch, access: restricted, @changesets/changelog-github). Leave URLs and reference links unchanged.

6. If the counterpart already exists, update only what changed to keep them equivalent; do not restructure it. If it does not exist, create it.

7. To avoid an infinite loop: if the counterpart is already an accurate, up-to-date translation of the saved file, make no changes.
